headword: プライバシーポリシー
reading: ぷらいばしーぽりしー

definitions.explanation: A published statement setting out how an organization collects, uses, and protects personal information. Standard on Japanese company websites and apps.

examples.japanese: プライバシーポリシーを{読|よ}んだ。
{当社|とうしゃ}のプライバシーポリシーは{下記|かき}のとおりです。
examples.english: Our privacy policy is as follows.

examples.japanese: {個人情報|こじんじょうほう}の{取|と}り{扱|あつか}いについては、プライバシーポリシーに{同意|どうい}のうえご{利用|りよう}ください。
examples.english: Regarding the handling of personal information, please agree to the privacy policy before using the service.

notes:
From English "privacy policy". Belongs to formal written register — websites, contracts, app setup screens — and is rarely said aloud.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プライバシーポリシーに{同意|どうい}する: to agree to the privacy policy
- プライバシーポリシーを{定|さだ}める: to establish a privacy policy
- プライバシーポリシーの{改定|かいてい}: revision of the privacy policy
- プライバシーポリシーを{確認|かくにん}する: to check the privacy policy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {個人情報|こじんじょうほう}{保護|ほご}{方針|ほうしん}: the Japanese equivalent — the two often appear side by side as a heading and its gloss
- {利用|りよう}{規約|きやく}: terms of service — the companion document, covering rules of use rather than data handling
